title: manuscript-guard hierarchies of evidence
description: The hierarchies a reading of a cited work places it on, each with its scales, one for each kind of question, and on each scale its levels: whole numbers from 1, 1 the strongest. The toolkit's own (data/evidence_hierarchies.yaml) holds the Oxford 2011 Levels of Evidence in its own words; a project may declare another in a file of this shape, named in paper.yaml under `references.hierarchy`.

citation.description: The hierarchy's own citation, as its authors ask for it.

introduction.description: The citation of the document it is to be read with.

question.description: The kind of question the scale is for.

levels.description: Each level by its number, 1 the strongest, with a short description.
